name: lean-proof-fill
description: Insert AI-suggested Lean 4 proof steps at the cursor using GitHub Copilot. Press again to get a different suggestion.

leanProofFill.modelFamily.description: Copilot model family to use (e.g. "gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4"). Leave empty to use the first available Copilot model. Use the 'Lean Proof Fill: Select Copilot Model' command to pick from a list.

leanProofFill.modelTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model to finish a reply before cancelling the request (seconds).

leanProofFill.verify.description: Check each suggestion with Lean before accepting it. Suggestions that Lean rejects are retried automatically (with Lean's errors fed back to the model); if none passes, the file is left unchanged.

leanProofFill.maxAttempts.description: How many suggestions to try per button press when verification is on, before giving up.

leanProofFill.verifyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Lean to finish checking a suggestion. If Lean takes longer, the suggestion is left in place and marked as not verified.

enumDescriptions: Rewrite the accepted proof on a single line (tactics joined with ';'). Re-checked by Lean; kept on several lines if it can't be written on one line (e.g. calc) or the one-line form doesn't check.
Insert the proof exactly as the model wrote it.
Replace the proof with a `from_base64 "..."` call that encodes it (needs the SorryClaude.Base64 module).
leanProofFill.acceptedProofFormat.description: How to write a proof into the file once Lean has verified it. Requires leanProofFill.verify.

leanProofFill.base64Module.description: The Lean module providing the `from_base64` tactic, imported when leanProofFill.acceptedProofFormat is "base64" and by the Encode Selection command.

leanProofFill.base64AutoImport.description: If the Base64 tactic module is not imported, add the import automatically (this is the one change made outside the cursor). If off, the proof is left as plain text when the import is missing.

leanProofFill.contextLines.description: Maximum number of lines of the file (centred on the cursor) sent to the model as context.

leanProofFill.extraInstructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the prompt (e.g. "Prefer Mathlib tactics like linarith and simp").

leanProofFill.showPromptOnRequest.description: Automatically open the 'Lean Proof Fill' output panel showing the prompt sent to the model (and its reply) each time a suggestion is requested.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node test/format.test.js && node test/check.test.js && node test/encode.test.js && node test/singleline.test.js && node test/askmodel.test.js && node test/waitforlean.test.js && node test/flow.test.js
